data.description: 马莱的街巷里，三笠穿着黑色军装制服走在异国的屋檐下，胸甲与束带收束出挺拔的轮廓，红围巾在灰暗的色调中是唯一的亮色——「无论走到哪里，我都会找到你。」
data.promptProse: Walking with quiet resolve down a narrow Liberio cobblestone lane beneath weathered masonry eaves, Mikasa wears her black Marley tactical uniform with fitted chest plate and leather straps. Her gaze stays alert along the road ahead, the deep crimson fold of her red scarf standing out sharply against the muted gray stonework and dark uniform. Flat overcast daylight washes the foreign street behind her without harsh shadows.
data.title: 三笠 · 马莱街头
data.animaCaption: Walking steadily along the quiet Liberio cobblestone street beneath stone eaves in her black tactical uniform, Mikasa scans the road ahead with solemn alertness. Her red scarf forms a vivid accent beneath the cool overcast sky.
